WITH logged_sms AS (
    INSERT INTO sms_event_log (
        telerivet_message_id,
        sender_number,
        receiver_number,
        location_name,
        asset_name,
        asset_key,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        raw_message
    )
    VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        $6,
        $7,
        $8::timestamptz,
        $9
    )
    ON CONFLICT (telerivet_message_id)
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id
)

UPDATE fault_incidents
SET
    status = 'RECTIFIED',
    restoration_time = $8::timestamptz,
    restoration_message = $9,
    restoration_sms_id = $1,

    downtime_seconds = EXTRACT(
        EPOCH FROM (
            $8::timestamptz - failure_time
        )
    )::bigint,

    updated_at = NOW()

WHERE id = (
    SELECT id
    FROM fault_incidents
    WHERE
        asset_key = $6
        AND status = 'OPEN'
        AND failure_time <= $8::timestamptz
    ORDER BY failure_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

RETURNING
    id,
    location_name,
    asset_name,
    status,
    failure_time,
    restoration_time,
    downtime_seconds;

WITH logged_sms AS (
    INSERT INTO sms_event_log (
        telerivet_message_id,
        sender_number,
        receiver_number,
        location_name,
        asset_name,
        asset_key,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        raw_message
    )
    VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        $6,
        $7,
        $8::timestamptz,
        $9
    )
    ON CONFLICT (telerivet_message_id)
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id
)

INSERT INTO fault_incidents (
    location_name,
    asset_name,
    asset_key,
    status,
    failure_time,
    failure_message,
    failure_sms_id,
    sender_number
)
VALUES (
    $4,
    $5,
    $6,
    'OPEN',
    $8::timestamptz,
    $9,
    $1,
    $2
)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING
    id,
    location_name,
    asset_name,
    status,
    failure_time;

SELECT
    id,
    location_name,
    asset_name,
    status,

    failure_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
        AS failure_time_ist,

    restoration_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
        AS restoration_time_ist,

    downtime_seconds,

    CASE
        WHEN status = 'OPEN'
        THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - failure_time))::bigint
        ELSE downtime_seconds
    END AS effective_downtime_seconds,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'OPEN')
        OVER () AS total_open_faults,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE failure_time >=
        (
            date_trunc(
                'day',
                NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
            ) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
        )
    ) OVER () AS failures_today,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE status = 'RECTIFIED'
        AND restoration_time >=
        (
            date_trunc(
                'day',
                NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
            ) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
        )
    ) OVER () AS rectified_today,

    AVG(downtime_seconds) FILTER (
        WHERE status = 'RECTIFIED'
    ) OVER () AS average_downtime_seconds

FROM fault_incidents
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN status = 'OPEN' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    failure_time DESC

LIMIT 500;
